main_text.l: 2 An necesse sit, quamlibet artem liberalem habere certum, proprium & adæquatum finem? ibid.
3 An necesse sit finem tuiuslibet artis liberalis ita esse comparatum, vt ab ea certo præstari possit? 13
4 An necesse sit, quamlibet artem liberalem certum, proprium & adæquatum subjectum habere, in quo explicando occupetur? 14
5 An necesse sit, certas leges constituendi & examinandi præcepta artium dari, & quanam illa sint? 15
6 An necesse sit, quamlibet artem liberalem certam & methodicam habere præceptorum dispositionem, & quanam illa sit? 18
7 An ars liberalis debeat esse amula [?] natura & quomodo? 20

page.notes: Long s is printed as s in the index entries and is transcribed here as s only where it appears in the scan; check the "pos[?]" and "eas[?]" readings, which are cut at the edge of the image. The left edge of the text is cut off, so the first lines are fragments and the first paragraph is marked cont="true". "eriote" is a doubtful reading (possibly "eriore"). The page references in the question list are read as printed; "12" is uncertain. "amula" (aemula?) and "duz" (dux?) are doubtful. The ornamental band is not text.
